summary: Flagsmith provides a centralised dashboard, API, and client-side SDKs to manage feature flags across your software applications. It serves as a self-hosted alternative to proprietary feature toggle platforms like LaunchDarkly. You can use it to remotely control application features without needing to deploy new code.
goodFor: Development teams who want to control software releases dynamically while keeping full ownership of their feature flag data and infrastructure.
watchOut: Self-hosting adds operational overhead for managing high availability and ensuring your flag evaluation API remains responsive, as any downtime directly impacts your applications.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on container orchestration tools like Docker or Kubernetes, requiring persistent storage for the database and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
